sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of tetrabenazine or its deuterated form, deutetrabenazine, during breastfeeding. If a mother requires tetrabenazine or deutetrabenazine it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Monitor the breastfed infant for drowsiness, adequate weight gain, and developmental milestones, especially in younger, exclusively breastfed infants and when using combinations of psychotropic drugs.
